questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Ivory Coast?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ivory Coast article.

questions.proof: The capital of Côte d'Ivoire is Yamoussoukro but its biggest city is Abidjan.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Ivory Coast?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Ivory Coast on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Ivory Coast article.

questions.proof: Liberia is to the southwest, Guinea to the northwest, Mali to the north-northwest, Burkina Faso to the north-northeast, and Ghana to the east.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “It borders the Gulf of _____ to the south and five other African nations.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Gulf”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: It is further down the Ivory Coast article, under the heading “Geography”.

questions.proof: It borders the Gulf of Guinea to the south and five other African nations.
